claims.quote: Betta livida is a small bubble-nesting labyrinth fish endemic to peat swamps in northern Selangor state, Peninsular Malaysia.
Betta livida is endemic to the north Selangor peat swamp forest and southern Perak in Peninsular Malaysia.
